info.name: Graze Smasher Product Hunting Tool REST API
info.description: REST API collection for third-party platforms integrating with the Graze Smasher Fake Review Detection Engine (CS619).

request.description: Allows external e-commerce platforms to ingest a product along with customer reviews. Each review is analyzed via Calibrated SVM + J-48 + Heuristics.
Submits an individual customer review to an existing product. Analyzes textual and behavioral patterns in real time.
Lists all monitored products with pagination, search, category filters, and authenticity scores.
Returns full details for a product including its community trust rating and fake review count.
Returns paginated reviews for a product with optional label filtering.
